difficulty_reason: A composition of pseudo-coherent morphisms of schemes is pseudo-coherent. The retained proof translates to ring maps A -> B -> C, both pseudo-coherent, so A -> C is pseudo-coherent, and resolves this by citing either of two More on Algebra lemmas (pull-relative-pseudo-coherent or composition-relative-pseudo-coherent). The cited algebra is the whole content; the author keeps no independent argument. Retained author proof at lines 17407-17416.
